t.E133.agn: In 2010 EFSA lowered the ADI for brilliant blue FCF from 10 to 6 mg/kg body weight. In the refined estimate, intakes remained below this limit.
t.E133.body: In rats, almost all of the orally administered brilliant blue FCF was excreted unchanged in faeces and none was found in urine. In dogs, the amount passing into bile did not exceed 5% of the dose.
t.E133.prod: A dye produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E133.regx.0: ADI lowered to 6 mg/kg; below the limit in the refined estimate.
t.E133.summary: A synthetic, bright blue dye. It is used in confectionery, drinks and ice cream; together with yellow dyes it gives a green colour.
t.E133.what: Gives a blue colour; together with yellow it produces green shades.
